# highlight

## Overview
Syntax highlighting (DartSyntaxHighlighter, DartColorsAndFontsPage) and error filtering for Dart.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.highlight.DartSyntaxHighlighter
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.highlight.DartColorsAndFontsPage
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.highlight.DartHighlightingErrorFilter

## Invariants
- Maps Dart token types to TextAttributesKey styles.

## Side Effects
- Renders syntax highlighting attributes in IDE editor.
